objects.taxonomy_description: Small to medium-sized macropod marsupial measuring 45-105 cm in body length with tail adding 35-75 cm. Exhibits characteristic kangaroo body plan with disproportionately large muscular hind limbs adapted for saltatorial locomotion, small forelimbs with five digits, and thick muscular tail used for balance. Fur coloration varies by species, displaying grey, brown, red, or black tones, often with distinctive facial markings including pale cheek stripes and dark eye bands. Ears are relatively short and rounded compared to kangaroos. Pouch opens anteriorly. Body exhibits bilateral symmetry with digitigrade hind foot posture. Weight ranges 1-25 kg depending on species. Agile leaping gait with tail providing counterbalance during bipedal hopping.
